name: Marginalia
author: Sajjad Heydari
description: A hidden context menu on cards, verbs, aspects and the board: notes, board labels, rulers for laying out cards, pausing when a verb finishes or a card is about to decay, and the wiki in game. Alt + right-click.
description_long:
This mod uses AI generated code.

A hidden context menu for Cultist Simulator. Hold [b]Alt[/b] and [b]right-click[/b] a card, verb, aspect icon, an open window, or the bare table.

[b]Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2901287611]GHIRBI[/url][/b], because this is a DLL mod. Restart the game after enabling it.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Write a persistent note on any card, verb or aspect. Notes are shared across all your saves.
[*]The menu previews the note. Enter starts a new line, Ctrl+Enter keeps it, Esc discards it.
[/list]

[h2]Board labels[/h2]
[list]
[*]Alt + right-click the table and pick [i]Write on the board…[/i]. The text sits under the cards and pans and zooms with the table.
[*]Alt + right-click a label to edit, resize or rub it out. Alt + left-drag to move it.
[/list]

[h2]Rulers[/h2]
[list]
[*]Alt + right-click the table and pick [i]Add grid…[/i], [i]Add line (H)…[/i] or [i]Add line (V)…[/i]. Sliders set the size in cards.
[*]Grids are card-sized cells; lines are ticked every card width or height. Rulers snap so their cells line up with where the game snaps cards.
[*]They never move or sort your cards. They're only guides for laying things out by hand.
[*]Alt + right-click a ruler to resize or remove it. Alt + left-drag to move it.
[/list]

[h2]Pausing[/h2]
[list]
[*]On a verb, pick [i]Pause at every step…[/i] to pause each time its timer runs out, or [i]Pause at the end[/i] to pause only when its results are waiting.
[*]On a card that decays, pick [i]Pause before it decays…[/i]. It applies to every card of that kind.
[*]A slider sets how long before the timer runs out to pause, from right after it ends up to 35 seconds before.
[*]The pause lands on the exact moment at any game speed, and a gold ring pulses around whatever caused it.
[*][i]Step time 0.1 s forward[/i] on the board menu moves a paused game on by a tenth of a second.
[/list]

[h2]Wiki[/h2]
[list]
[*][i]Open wiki[/i] shows the item's Cultist Simulator Wiki article in an in-game window, with working links and a Back button. [i]Browser[/i] opens it in the Steam overlay. Needs an internet connection.
[/list]

[h2]Details[/h2]
Notes, labels, rulers and pauses are stored in marginalia.json, marginalia_board.json, marginalia_rulers.json and marginalia_pauses.json next to your save files. On Steam they also sync through Steam Cloud, so they follow you between computers. To use a different modifier, add marginalia_modifier=ctrl (or shift) to config.ini. Some Linux window managers grab Alt + right-drag; try ctrl if the menu never appears.

Unofficial fan mod, not affiliated with Weather Factory or Fandom. Source: [url=https://github.com/MCSH/cultist-simulator-marginalia]github.com/MCSH/cultist-simulator-marginalia[/url]
